description: Incrementally update an existing codebase index. Only re-indexes changed files. Runs synchronously. Use it to refresh a manual/off snapshot, working-tree edits before the next Git transition in git mode, or whenever an immediate catch-up is needed.

extraExtensions.description: Comma-separated list of additional file extensions to index (e.g. '.tpl,.blade').

projectPath.description: Absolute path to the project directory.

name: codebase_update
